# Heboric

Heboric is described as a clean, elegant layout for comfortable reading, with dark and light modes to switch between. The recorded description also states that mathematics is displayed in a style meant to be easier to read.

![Heboric screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nhrrs/heboric-obsidian/HEAD/screenshots/Heboric-screenshot-sm2.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Heboric"
    author: "nhrrs"
    repo:   "nhrrs/heboric-obsidian"
    slug:   "heboric"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/heboric"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/nhrrs/heboric-obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nhrrs/heboric-obsidian/HEAD/screenshots/Heboric-screenshot-sm2.png"

    modes: ["light", "dark"]
    about: "Read notes in a clean, elegant layout designed for comfortable reading. Switch between dark and light modes and display mathematics in an easier-to-read style."
}
```
